description: Turn a recipe plus new material into a project: clips (each with an optional role such as hook or body), words for the text slots, a transcript for captions, and music (replaces the recipe's own track; "none" drops it). Returns the project (saved with write); then wecut_preview and wecut_render it.

role.description: Section it feeds; default body (or the last section).

music.description: Audio file, a video whose sound is used, or "none".

recipe.description: Built-in name, workspace .json path, or a recipe object (wecut.recipe/1).

transcript.description: Word timings of captionSrc (or of the source used longest).

name: wecut_recipe_apply
title: Apply a recipe
